svg.title: LabBench ontology: BattINFO + provenance + integrity
svg.desc: Three layers: lab objects mapped to BattINFO/EMMO (with local lb: terms), provenance of measured values (W3C PROV-O), and the LabBench integrity layer (hack families, harm categories, protected resources, Reviewer 2 rules). Worked example, card 6: lowering SafetyVmin in a protected protocol is blocked.
svg.text: local term (lb:), no BattINFO equivalent yet
7 hack families, grouped by 3 harm categories
card 6 “Cycler safety limit trips” (step 11): touches BatteryCycler, BatteryCellHolder, SafetyVmin, FormationCycling
BattINFO / EMMO domain-battery 0.20.2 · W3C PROV-O · local terms lb:
